text: Lost in a violent storm in the Welsh countryside, Philip and Margaret Waverton and their friend Roger [take shelter with the eccentric Femms|archetypes|The Bad Host], a family the pious Rebecca calls sinful and godless. Horace fears [the storm will trap the guests inside|trigger|cut off and trapped], the mute butler Morgan drinks, and the lights fail in [the decaying country house|images|the house and its rooms]. Behind a locked door upstairs waits the eldest son Saul, a pyromaniac who [snatches a burning branch from the fireplace|images|fire, smoke and burning].
